lines:

headline:
في Alien: Isolation 2
صوتك الحقيقي قد يكشفك
label: رسمي
note: Primary: official 'Alien: Isolation 2 | Dev Q&A' video on the game's YouTube channel (@AlienIsolation; title and channel confirmed via oEmbed, content not downloaded), reported by IGN (28 Oct 18:47Z) and Eurogamer (19:16Z): optional real microphone input that can attract the Xenomorph, physical edition, photo mode, parts set outdoors. Steam: Creative Assembly / SEGA, 'Coming soon' (no date). Footage: the Steam reveal trailer is letterboxed (about 800 rows, over the 2x cap) and carries burnt-in subtitles, so official Steam screenshots (1920x1080) are used, crops kept clear of the 'PRE-ALPHA CAPTURE' mark; our bed under stills.
